scope: Read-only diagnosis of synthetic repeat-finalization construction; no tracked edits, test execution, HTTP, or Git operations.

cause.construction: type(consumer).__new__ followed only by Transform.__init__ bypasses all MediaDive subclass initialization, including the mandatory sealed-generation consumer.
cause.failure: MediaDiveTransform.finalize calls self._endpoint_consumer.restore(report_path) before the recorded recipe/public input checks. Missing attribute produces AttributeError, so the intended SourceFinalizationRequired assertion is never reached.

production_assessment.constructor: MediaDiveTransform.__init__ sets selected bulk_data_dir and calls _load_bulk_data unconditionally before returning.
production_assessment.guard_creation: _load_bulk_data constructs EndpointConsumer, assigns its shared admission, then loads all four native payloads. It re-raises any exception; a constructor failure cannot return a usable producer.
production_assessment.cli_path: transform._run_one constructs via DATA_SOURCES[source], which invokes the full registered class constructor before run/finalize.
production_assessment.limitation: Manually bypassed or corrupted instances can still raise AttributeError in this restore branch. That is not evidence of a normal construction/publication bypass; verify_native_inputs separately rejects a missing endpoint guard. No production change is needed to repair this fixture.

proposed_fixture_only_repair.why: Runs the actual subclass native-read initialization against the existing sealed fixture generation. New EndpointConsumer and source snapshots are created by genuine reads; no original in-memory consumer/recipe guard or damaged completion snapshots are copied.
proposed_fixture_only_repair.avoid: Do not call read_mediadive_bulk_inputs helper: it additionally prepares recipe/material guards and alters the fresh restore path. Do not create a fake endpoint consumer, widen expected exception to AttributeError, skip repeated.finalize, or weaken production validation.
preserved_adversarial_assertions: Current public source verification raises SourceFinalizationRequired.
Public merge raises SourceFinalizationRequired before KGX.
Fresh repeat-finalize raises SourceFinalizationRequired on the damaged persisted evidence.
Every source output byte and prior published archive remains unchanged.
All six persisted metadata damage cases and changed-lookup/hash-restamp cases remain active.
optional_narrow_setup_assertions: bacdive_taxon_lookup is absent from repeated.consumed_input_snapshots before finalize
proposed_fixture_only_repair.validation_when_root_allows: Run this module and existing fresh/repeated MediaDive finalization controls; root controls pytest. No failure has been rerun here.

search.finding: Targeted bypass/deletion search found synthetic __new__ constructions in tests, no matching production deletion/reset of _endpoint_consumer.
